parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: It generates airflow by rotating at high speed, driven by an electric motor, to cool electronic components or circulate air.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support for the fan blades and motor.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary, serving as the mounting structure for the rotating fan assembly.
